rows.text:
- The 2b07dd6 full run passed build, 41 model and 571 unit/integration tests; browser result was 250/251. The remaining failure was a 15-second #prompt setup timeout, before the notification scenario.
- Inspection review corrected its initial Add inside diagnosis. Commit de2b5fa waits for the real compiled preview before the unchanged shell-readiness check; product code, timeouts and assertions are unchanged.
- The complete browser replay finished 249/251: a detached viewport resample and review approval checked before operation completion were investigated separately. The original approval timing cause was not established.
- Reviewed fixture corrections retain the successful measured viewport sample and require successful/persisted approval before the unchanged UI assertion. Both focused cases pass; strict final validation and formal acceptance remain pending.
